name: Values stack to wordmark close
looks: Three one-word values stack in on a dark field, each new word landing bright while the one before it dims, finishing with all three visible and the last brightest. It hard-cuts to a light field where a tagline types on, then the full wordmark and logo lock up, finally dropping the lockup's icon-only initial state to reveal the full name with a URL caption beneath.
build: List-stack-reveal for the three values. The tagline types on with terminal-type-on's per-character mechanic in a plain sans face (no panel). The wordmark lockup is a hard cut from the icon mark alone to icon-plus-wordmark at full size, then a scale-down crossfade to the final lockup with the URL caption fading in beneath.
sound: A tick per value landing, a typing tick under the tagline, then a soft confirm hit on the final wordmark lockup.
prompt: Close on three one-word brand values stacking in, the last staying bright. Cut to a plain field where a short tagline types on, then settle on the full logo lockup with the product name and a URL caption, as the film's final signature.
